verdict.line: You lose if Irelia dives off minion-assisted Q resets and snowballs kills before level 6; you win the 55.9% matchup (102 games) once Thornmail and Enrage's health stacking take over from level 9 on.

brief.thesis: Irelia's whole early game runs on Q (Bladesurge) resets and stacking Passive (Ionian Fervor) for bonus on-hit damage — she wins trades by chaining dashes off minions and autos. Sion has zero tools to punish a dash before level 6, so the lane is genuinely dangerous early, but his Passive (Feel No Pain) and E's permanent max-health growth on kills mean every minion and skirmish he survives makes the next trade safer, flipping the matchup once his core items land.

theirWindow.what: She can chain Q (Bladesurge) off a minion to dash onto you for free damage and a reset if it kills the minion. Per OP.GG's own read on this matchup, give up the minion and back off rather than contest it — a solo kill here is her biggest lane swing.

yourWindow.what: Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s and only refreshes on a Marked or killed target, so if she's just used it on a minion with no mark up, she has no gap-close or escape for several seconds. Walk up and land Q (Cryptic Gaze) for the stun into W (Death's Caress), then detonate the shield early for the burst.

start.why: 57.6% win rate over 66 games (54.1% pick) — the passive damage reduction on harass directly counters her poking you down with Q resets while you can't yet fight back.

boots.why: 54.6% win rate over 108 games (90% pick) — Irelia's damage is almost entirely basic attacks once Passive is stacked, and flat physical reduction per hit undercuts her on-hit scaling directly.

core.why: early anti-heal and armor blunts her Q (Bladesurge) self-heal on every dash, so her resets stop paying for themselves
gives you the HP and passive burn to win extended trades where her stacking Passive used to win the fight
punishes her at max Passive stacks — the moment her on-hit damage bonus kicks in, Thornmail reflects it straight back
stacks more HP and anti-heal on top, cutting further into her Q sustain in long games — 71.4% win rate over this build path (10.5% pick)

situational.when: the game goes long and you need the extra magic resist and tenacity on top of your armor stack
you're ahead and want your E (Enrage) max-health growth to scale into even more raw stats
you want stronger wave clear and a bigger all-in once you're past the early solo-kill window

runes.keystoneWhy: procs off autos for bonus damage, healing, and permanent max-health growth — it directly offsets the health you lose to E (Enrage) and keeps you ahead of her Q (Bladesurge) self-heal in sustained trades.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is run in 87.4% of games at 56.7% win rate — Teleport lets you reset with full Doran's Shield sustain after an early loss instead of conceding the wave, while Flash dodges her Q dash-in or an E (Flawless Duet) stun angle.

playing.title: Give up contested minions early
playing.detail: At levels 2-3, don't fight her for a minion she can Q (Bladesurge) through — a kill refreshes her dash onto you for free. This is the exact scenario OP.GG flags as her biggest lane-winning window.

playing.title: Trade only when her Q is down
playing.detail: Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s with no refresh unless it marks or kills something. If she's just burned it on a minion with nothing marked, step up and land Q (Cryptic Gaze) into W (Death's Caress).

playing.title: Don't auto-trade into her healing Q
playing.detail: E (Enrage) trades your health for AD on every auto, but her Q heals her back on hit — prolonged auto wars favor her early. Wait for a Grasp proc or your shield before committing.

playing.title: Shield-tank her E mark
playing.detail: W (Death's Caress) absorbs damage before it explodes, so pop it before she can land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark rather than eating it raw.

playing.title: Hold all-ins until level 6
playing.detail: R (Cannibalism) gives you lifesteal-on-attack and bonus attack speed for 90s — don't commit to a full all-in before it's up.

playing.title: Lean on Thornmail once she's stacked
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor's bonus on-hit damage at max stacks is exactly what Thornmail punishes — once it's built, invite the extended trade instead of avoiding it.

playing.title: Use Teleport to erase early losses
playing.detail: Doran's Shield sustain plus Teleport lets you return to lane at full health after a bad level 2-5 stretch, keeping the long-game advantage intact.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful when she closes in using minions when she is level 2~3. Do not let he close in when she has 5 (P) stacks by keeping your distance.
